pick.headline: Lebanese deputies approve the Taif Agreement
pick.summary: On October 22, 1989, Lebanese parliamentarians meeting in Taif, Saudi Arabia, approved a national reconciliation charter to end the civil war.
pick.significance: The agreement rebalanced power between Christians and Muslims and was backed by the US, Saudi Arabia and Syria.
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of October 23, 1989, carried Voice of Lebanon on envoy Ibrahimi briefing Aoun on the Taif results, and Paris AFP on Aoun rejecting the accord, saying acceptance "would be a crime for me".
